text:
alex_cheng: Heads up — we received a partial DOA batch from vendor for the EU edge pool (15 units, 3 DOA). Can vendor confirm serials + if replacements are in EU stock?
joan_vendor: Sorry — confirmed 3 DOA due to firmware mismatch. We have 2 units in DE depot, 1 in NL crossdock. ETA for air uplift: 48-72h to DE, 5-7 days to NL via sea. Can you accept split AWB?
maria_gonzalez: Split AWB is ok. Need customs HS code and insurance value for NL leg. Also request expedite air for the one going to our Warsaw cluster — cost acceptable up to $3k.
min-ops: +1 on Warsaw priority. Also note crossdock in NL needs depot acceptance window 2 hours. Please include palletization notes.
ops-bot: Incident #INC-2024-402: Warsaw cluster degraded after 3 failed GPUs. Auto-failover triggered. Prioritize replacement.
lucas_w: Can we do temporary hot-swap with loaner units from DE depot to avoid capacity hit? Query vendor for loaner availability.
joan_vendor: We can allocate 2 loaners from DE depot for 14 days. Need loaner agreement signed. AWB draft: MAWB 125-777888, HAWB 125-777888-01 (DE->WAW).
alex_cheng: Upload loaner agreement to S3 and tag @maria_gonzalez for signatures. Also we need RMA labels for DOA return. Preference: consolidated AWB back to vendor depot.
joan_vendor: Will send return labels in same booking. Note: DOA serials must be on manifest or depot will refuse. Sending manifest in next message.
joan_vendor: ```manifest:
- SN: RTX-00011234
- SN: RTX-00011235
- SN: RTX-00011236
```
maria_gonzalez: Confirmed — bundle manifest with MAWB and depot contact (NL crossdock: +31 20 555 1234). Please add firmware build id and DOA reason code.
joan_vendor: firmware: v2.1.7, reason: boot-loop on POST. We'll expedite replacement booking now. Expected pickup from NL crossdock in 24h.
min-ops: Could we get cost credit if we accept loaners? We had ~18 hours of down time.
joan_vendor: For DOA, standard RMA covers replacement cost. For downtime credit, vendor offer: one-time service credit of $1,500. Will propose formal SLA credit.
alex_cheng: Ok proceed with split AWB / loaner booking. Keep us posted with AWB numbers and tracking. Thanks :thumbsup:
